scripts.build: bun run --bun tsc --noEmit && bun run --bun vite build --configLoader native
scripts.serve: bun run migrate:serve && OPENQUEST_PERSIST_PATH=.runtime/state OPENQUEST_MIGRATIONS=external OPENQUEST_PORT=4173 bun scripts/start-local-worker.mjs
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --bun wrangler deploy
scripts.migrate:local: bun run --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply openquest --local
scripts.migrate:serve: bun run --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply openquest --local --persist-to .runtime/state
scripts.migrate:remote: bun run --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply openquest --remote
scripts.demo:seed:local: bun run --bun wrangler d1 execute openquest --local --file demo/seed.sql
scripts.demo:setup:local: bun run demo:migrate:local && bun run demo:seed:local && bun run demo:verify:local
scripts.demo:seed:serve: bun run --bun wrangler d1 execute openquest --local --persist-to .runtime/state --file demo/seed.sql
scripts.demo:setup:serve: bun run demo:migrate:serve && bun run demo:seed:serve && bun run demo:verify:serve
scripts.demo:seed:remote: bun run --bun wrangler d1 execute openquest --remote --file demo/seed.sql
